                    return True
            except:
                if str(abs_path) == str(ex) or str(abs_path).startswith(str(ex) + os.sep):
                    return True
        return False

    collected = []
    for fp in opts["file_paths"]:
        p = pathlib.Path(fp)
        if not p.exists():
            collected.append(str(p))
            continue
        if p.is_file():
            if is_excluded(str(p)):
                continue
            collected.append(str(p))
        elif p.is_dir():
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(p), topdown=True):
                if not opts["hidden"]:
                    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                for fname in list(files):
                    if not opts["hidden"] and fname.startswith('.'):
                        continue
                    fpath = os.path.join(root, fname)
                    if not opts["hidden"] and is_hidden_path(fpath):
                        continue
                    if not fname.endswith('.nix'):
                        continue
                    if is_excluded(fpath):
                        continue
                    collected.append(fpath)
        else:
            collected.append(str(p))
    return collected

class Token:
    def __init__(self, typ, val, line, col, end_line, end_col, offset, end_offset):
        self.typ=typ
        self.val=val
        self.line=line
        self.col=col
        self.end_line=end_line
        self.end_col=end_col
        self.offset=offset
        self.end_offset=end_offset
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Token({self.typ},{self.val!r},{self.line}:{self.col})"

def lex_source(source):
    tokens=[]
    i=0
    line=1
    col=1
    offset=0
    n=len(source)
    while i<n:
        c=source[i]
        if c=='\n':
            line+=1
            col=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c.isspace():
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='#':
            start_line=line
            start_col=col
            start_offset=offset
            j=i
            while j<n and source[j]!='\n':
                j+=1
            comment=source[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('COMMENT',comment,start_line,start_col,line,start_col+len(comment),start_offset, start_offset+len(comment)))
            col+=len(comment)
            offset+=len(comment)
            i=j
            continue
        if source.startswith('/*',i):
            start_line=line
            start_col=col
            start_offset=offset
            j=i+2
            col+=2
            offset+=2
            depth=1
            while j<n and depth>0:
                if source.startswith('/*',j):
                    depth+=1
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                elif source.startswith('*/',j):
                    depth-=1
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                    if depth==0:
                        break
                else:
                    if source[j]=='\n':
                        line+=1
                        col=1
                    else:
                        col+=1
                    offset+=1
                    j+=1
            comment=source[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('COMMENT',comment,start_line,start_col,line,col,start_offset, offset))
            i=j
            continue
        if source.startswith("''",i):
            start_line=line
            start_col=col
            start_offset=offset
            j=i+2
            col+=2
            offset+=2
            while j<n:
                if source.startswith("''",j):
                    if j+2 < n and source[j+2]=='$':
                        j+=3
                        col+=3
                        offset+=3
                        continue
                    if j+2 < n and source[j+2]=="'":
                        j+=3
                        col+=3
                        offset+=3
                        continue
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                    break
                elif source.startswith("${",j):
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                    depth=1
                    while j<n and depth>0:
                        if source[j]=='{':
                            depth+=1
                        elif source[j]=='}':
                            depth-=1
                        elif source[j]=='\n':
                            line+=1
                            col=1
                            offset+=1
                            j+=1
                            continue
                        else:
                            col+=1
                        offset+=1
                        j+=1
                    continue
                else:
                    if source[j]=='\n':
                        line+=1
                        col=1
                    else:
                        col+=1
                    offset+=1
                    j+=1
            content=source[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('STRING',content,start_line,start_col,line,col,start_offset, offset))
            i=j
            continue
        if c=='"':
            start_line=line
            start_col=col
            start_offset=offset
            j=i+1
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            while j<n:
                if source[j]=='\\':
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                    continue
                if source.startswith("${",j):
                    j+=2
                    col+=2
                    offset+=2
                    depth=1
                    while j<n and depth>0:
                        if source[j]=='{':
                            depth+=1
                        elif source[j]=='}':
                            depth-=1
                        elif source[j]=='\n':
                            line+=1
                            col=1
                            offset+=1
                            j+=1
                            continue
                        else:
                            col+=1
                        offset+=1
                        j+=1
                    continue
                if source[j]=='"':
                    j+=1
                    col+=1
                    offset+=1
                    break
                if source[j]=='\n':
                    line+=1
                    col=1
                else:
                    col+=1
                offset+=1
                j+=1
            content=source[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('STRING',content,start_line,start_col,line,col,start_offset, offset))
            i=j
            continue
        if source.startswith('...',i):
            tokens.append(Token('ELLIPSIS','...',line,col,line,col+3,offset,offset+3))
            col+=3
            offset+=3
            i+=3
            continue
        if c in '{}()[];,:=':
            typ={'{':'LBRACE','}':'RBRACE','(':'LPAREN',')':'RPAREN','[':'LBRACK',']':'RBRACK',';':'SEMI',',':'COMMA',':':'COLON','=':'EQ'}[c]
            tokens.append(Token(typ,c,line,col,line,col+1,offset,offset+1))
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='.':
            tokens.append(Token('DOT','.',line,col,line,col+1,offset,offset+1))
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='@':
            tokens.append(Token('AT','@',line,col,line,col+1,offset,offset+1))
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c=='?':
            tokens.append(Token('QUESTION','?',line,col,line,col+1,offset,offset+1))
            col+=1
            offset+=1
            i+=1
            continue
        if c.isalpha() or c=='_':
            j=i
            while j<n and (source[j].isalnum() or source[j] in "_'-"):
                j+=1
            ident=source[i:j]
            kw_map={'let':'LET','in':'IN','with':'WITH','inherit':'INHERIT','rec':'REC','assert':'ASSERT','if':'IF','then':'THEN','else':'ELSE','or':'OR'}
            typ=kw_map.get(ident,'IDENT')
            tokens.append(Token(typ,ident,line,col,line,col+len(ident),offset,offset+len(ident)))
            col+=len(ident)
            offset+=len(ident)
            i=j
            continue
        if c.isdigit():
            j=i
            while j<n and source[j].isdigit():
                j+=1
            num=source[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token('INT',num,line,col,line,col+len(num),offset,offset+len(num)))
            col+=len(num)
            offset+=len(num)
            i=j
            continue
        tokens.append(Token('OP',c,line,col,line,col+1,offset,offset+1))
        col+=1
        offset+=1
        i+=1
    tokens.append(Token('EOF','',line,col,line,col,offset,offset))
    return tokens

class Binding:
    def __init__(self, name, line, col, end_col, typ, skipped=False, offset=None, end_offset=None):
        self.name=name
        self.line=line
        self.col=col
        self.end_col=end_col
        self.offset=offset
        self.end_offset=end_offset
        self.typ=typ
        self.skipped=skipped
        self.used=False
        self.is_underscore=name.startswith('_')
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Binding({self.name},{self.line}:{self.col},{self.typ},skipped={self.skipped},used={self.used})"

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens, source, opts):
        self.tokens=tokens
        self.pos=0
        self.source=source
        self.opts=opts
        self.scopes=[{}]
        self.all_bindings=[]
        self.diagnostics=[]
        self.skip_next_line=None

    def peek(self, k=0):
        idx=self.pos+k
        if idx < len(self.tokens):
            return self.tokens[idx]
        return self.tokens[-1]

    def consume(self, typ=None):
        tok=self.peek()
        if typ and tok.typ!=typ:
            self.diagnostics.append({"message":f"unexpected token {tok.val!r}, wanted {typ}","line":tok.line,"col":tok.col})
            return tok
        self.pos+=1
        return tok

    def skip_comments_and_check_pragma(self):
        while self.peek().typ=='COMMENT':
            tok=self.peek()
            if 'deadnix: skip' in tok.val:
                self.skip_next_line = tok.line + 1
            self.pos+=1

    def is_skipped(self, line):
        return self.skip_next_line == line

    def push_scope(self):
        self.scopes.append({})

    def pop_scope(self):
        if self.scopes:
            self.scopes.pop()

    def add_binding(self, binding):
        self.scopes[-1][binding.name]=binding
        self.all_bindings.append(binding)

    def lookup(self, name):
        for scope in reversed(self.scopes):
            if name in scope:
                return scope[name]
        return None

    def mark_used(self, name):
        b=self.lookup(name)
        if b:
            b.used=True

    def parse(self):
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        try:
            self.parse_expr()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()

    def parse_expr(self):
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        tok=self.peek()
        if tok.typ=='LET':
            self.parse_let()
        elif tok.typ=='WITH':
            self.consume('WITH')
            self.parse_expr()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                self.consume('SEMI')
            self.parse_expr()
        elif tok.typ=='ASSERT':
            self.consume('ASSERT')
            self.parse_expr()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                self.consume('SEMI')
            self.parse_expr()
        elif tok.typ=='IF':
            self.consume('IF')
            self.parse_expr()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='THEN':
                self.consume('THEN')
            self.parse_expr()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='ELSE':
                self.consume('ELSE')
            self.parse_expr()
        else:
            saved=self.pos
            saved_skip=self.skip_next_line
            try:
                bindings, alias_info, default_infos = self.try_parse_lambda_pattern()
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='COLON':
                    self.consume('COLON')
                    is_simple = len(bindings)==1 and bindings[0][1]=='simple'
                    self.push_scope()
                    for name, kind, tok, skipped in bindings:
                        typ = 'lambda_arg' if is_simple else 'lambda_pattern'
                        b = Binding(name, tok.line, tok.col, tok.col+len(name), typ, skipped, tok.offset, tok.end_offset)
                        self.add_binding(b)
                    if alias_info:
                        name, tok, skipped = alias_info
                        b = Binding(name, tok.line, tok.col, tok.col+len(name), 'lambda_pattern', skipped, tok.offset, tok.end_offset)
                        self.add_binding(b)
                    for start, end in default_infos:
                        for idx in range(start, end):
                            t = self.tokens[idx]
                            if t.typ=='IDENT':
                                self.mark_used(t.val)
                            elif t.typ=='STRING':
                                self.handle_string_interpol(t.val)
                    self.parse_expr()
                    self.pop_scope()
                    return
                else:
                    self.pos=saved
                    self.skip_next_line=saved_skip
            except Exception:
                self.pos=saved
                self.skip_next_line=saved_skip
            self.parse_or()

    def try_parse_lambda_pattern(self):
        bindings=[]
        default_infos=[]
        alias_info=None
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        if self.peek().typ=='IDENT' and self.peek(1).typ=='AT':
            alias_tok=self.consume('IDENT')
            self.consume('AT')
            alias_skipped=self.is_skipped(alias_tok.line)
            alias_info=(alias_tok.val, alias_tok, alias_skipped)
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='LBRACE':
                b, d = self.parse_attrset_pattern_inner()
                bindings.extend(b)
                default_infos.extend(d)
            elif self.peek().typ=='IDENT':
                tok=self.consume('IDENT')
                bindings.append((tok.val,'simple',tok,self.is_skipped(tok.line)))
            else:
                raise Exception("expected pattern after @")
            return bindings, alias_info, default_infos
        elif self.peek().typ=='LBRACE':
            b, d = self.parse_attrset_pattern_inner()
            bindings.extend(b)
            default_infos.extend(d)
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='AT':
                self.consume('AT')
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                alias_tok=self.consume('IDENT')
                alias_skipped=self.is_skipped(alias_tok.line)
                alias_info=(alias_tok.val, alias_tok, alias_skipped)
            return bindings, alias_info, default_infos
        elif self.peek().typ=='IDENT':
            tok=self.consume('IDENT')
            bindings.append((tok.val,'simple',tok,self.is_skipped(tok.line)))
            return bindings, None, []
        else:
            raise Exception("not lambda pattern")

    def parse_attrset_pattern_inner(self):
        bindings=[]
        default_infos=[]
        self.consume('LBRACE')
        while True:
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='RBRACE':
                self.consume('RBRACE')
                break
            if self.peek().typ=='ELLIPSIS':
                self.consume('ELLIPSIS')
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='COMMA':
                    self.consume('COMMA')
                continue
            if self.peek().typ=='IDENT':
                tok=self.consume('IDENT')
                skipped=self.is_skipped(tok.line)
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='QUESTION':
                    self.consume('QUESTION')
                    start_idx=self.pos
                    depth=0
                    while True:
                        t=self.peek()
                        if t.typ=='EOF':
                            break
                        if t.typ=='LBRACE' or t.typ=='LPAREN' or t.typ=='LBRACK':
                            depth+=1
                        elif t.typ=='RBRACE' or t.typ=='RPAREN' or t.typ=='RBRACK':
                            if depth==0:
                                break
                            depth-=1
                        elif t.typ=='COMMA' and depth==0:
                            break
                        elif t.typ=='RBRACE' and depth==0:
                            break
                        if depth==0 and t.typ in ('COMMA','RBRACE'):
                            break
                        self.pos+=1
                        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                    end_idx=self.pos
                    default_infos.append((start_idx, end_idx))
                bindings.append((tok.val,'pattern',tok,skipped))
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='COMMA':
                    self.consume('COMMA')
                continue
            else:
                self.pos+=1
                continue
        return bindings, default_infos

    def handle_string_interpol(self, s):
        i=0
        n=len(s)
        while i<n:
            if s.startswith('${',i):
                j=i+2
                depth=1
                start=j
                while j<n and depth>0:
                    if s[j]=='{':
                        depth+=1
                    elif s[j]=='}':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            break
                    j+=1
                if depth==0:
                    inner=s[start:j]
                    for m in re.finditer(r'[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_\'-]*', inner):
                        name=m.group(0)
                        if name in ('let','in','with','inherit','rec','assert','if','then','else','or'):
                            continue
                        self.mark_used(name)
                    j+=1
                    i=j
                    continue
            i+=1

    def parse_or(self):
        self.parse_and()
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        while self.peek().typ=='OR':
            self.consume('OR')
            self.parse_and()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()

    def parse_and(self):
        self.parse_expr_bin(0)

    def parse_expr_bin(self, min_prec):
        self.parse_app()
        while True:
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            tok=self.peek()
            # Check if tok is operator and has precedence
            # We'll handle common binary ops: + - * / ++ - etc., < > == != && || etc.
            # For simplicity, treat any OP as binary with low precedence, and also `++`, `//`, etc. as OP sequence
            # But we need to know if next token is OP or something like `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `<`, `>`, `=`, `!`, `&`, `|`
            if tok.typ!='OP':
                break
            # Determine precedence: for now, all binary ops have same low precedence, so we just consume one OP (or two-char OP) and then parse next app
            # Check for two-char ops like `++`, `//`, `==`, `!=`, `&&`, `||`, `->`, `//`, etc.
            # Our lexer tokenizes each char as OP, so `++` is two OP tokens `+` `+`
            # We need to handle that: if next token is also OP, combine?
            # For `used1 + x`, it's `used1` `+` `x`, so single OP `+`
            # For `a ++ b`, it would be `+` `+`
            # For simplicity, consume one or two OPs as a single operator
            op_start=self.pos
            op_str=tok.val
            self.consume('OP')
            # Check if next is also OP and forms known operator
            nxt=self.peek()
            if nxt.typ=='OP':
                # combine if forms known two-char op
                two=op_str+nxt.val
                if two in ('++','//','==','!=','&&','||','->','//','<=','>='):
                    op_str=two
                    self.consume('OP')
                elif op_str=='-' and nxt.val=='>':
                    op_str='->'
                    self.consume('OP')
            # Now parse next expr with higher precedence
            self.parse_app()

    def parse_app(self):
        self.parse_atom()
        while True:
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            tok=self.peek()
            if tok.typ in ('IDENT','INT','STRING','LBRACE','LPAREN','LBRACK'):
                self.parse_atom()
            else:
                break

    def parse_atom(self):
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        tok=self.peek()
        if tok.typ=='IDENT':
            ident=self.consume('IDENT')
            self.mark_used(ident.val)
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            while self.peek().typ=='DOT':
                self.consume('DOT')
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                t=self.peek()
                if t.typ=='IDENT':
                    self.consume('IDENT')
                elif t.typ=='STRING':
                    s=self.consume('STRING')
                    self.handle_string_interpol(s.val)
                elif t.typ=='INT':
                    self.consume('INT')
                else:
                    break
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        elif tok.typ=='STRING':
            s=self.consume('STRING')
            self.handle_string_interpol(s.val)
        elif tok.typ=='INT':
            self.consume('INT')
        elif tok.typ=='LPAREN':
            self.consume('LPAREN')
            self.parse_expr()
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='RPAREN':
                self.consume('RPAREN')
        elif tok.typ=='LBRACK':
            self.consume('LBRACK')
            while True:
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='RBRACK':
                    self.consume('RBRACK')
                    break
                if self.peek().typ=='EOF':
                    break
                self.parse_expr()
        elif tok.typ=='LBRACE':
            self.parse_attrset()
        elif tok.typ in ('LET','WITH','ASSERT','IF'):
            self.parse_expr()
        else:
            if tok.typ!='EOF':
                self.pos+=1

    def parse_attrset(self):
        self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        is_rec=False
        if self.peek().typ=='REC':
            self.consume('REC')
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
        self.consume('LBRACE')
        while True:
            self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
            if self.peek().typ=='RBRACE':
                self.consume('RBRACE')
                break
            if self.peek().typ=='EOF':
                break
            if self.peek().typ=='INHERIT':
                self.consume('INHERIT')
                if self.peek().typ=='LPAREN':
                    self.consume('LPAREN')
                    self.parse_expr()
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                    if self.peek().typ=='RPAREN':
                        self.consume('RPAREN')
                while self.peek().typ=='IDENT':
                    ident=self.consume('IDENT')
                    self.mark_used(ident.val)
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                    self.consume('SEMI')
            elif self.peek().typ=='IDENT':
                self.consume('IDENT')
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                while self.peek().typ=='DOT':
                    self.consume('DOT')
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                    t=self.peek()
                    if t.typ=='IDENT':
                        self.consume('IDENT')
                    elif t.typ=='STRING':
                        s=self.consume('STRING')
                        self.handle_string_interpol(s.val)
                    else:
                        break
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='EQ':
                    self.consume('EQ')
                    self.parse_expr()
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                    if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                        self.consume('SEMI')
                else:
                    if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                        self.consume('SEMI')
            elif self.peek().typ=='STRING':
                s=self.consume('STRING')
                self.handle_string_interpol(s.val)
                self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                if self.peek().typ=='EQ':
                    self.consume('EQ')
                    self.parse_expr()
                    self.skip_comments_and_check_pragma()
                    if self.peek().typ=='SEMI':
                        self.consume('SEMI')
            else:
                self.pos+=1

    def parse_let(self):
        self.consume('LET')
        scan_pos=self.pos
        depth=0
        in_pos=None
        for i in range(scan_pos, len(self.tokens)):
            t=self.tokens[i]
            if t.typ=='COMMENT':
                continue
            if t.typ=='LET':
                depth+=1
            elif t.typ=='IN':
                if depth==0:
                    in_pos=i
                    break
                else:
                    depth-=1
        if in_pos is None:
            self.diagnostics.append({"message":"unexpected end of file"})
            self.diagnostics.append({"message":"unexpected end of file, wanted any of [TOKEN_SEMICOLON]"})
            self.diagnostics.append({"message":"unexpected end of file"})
            self.diagnostics.append({"message":"unexpected end of file"})
            return
        temp_bindings=[]
        j=scan_pos
        while j < in_pos:
            while j < in_pos and self.tokens[j].typ=='COMMENT':
                if 'deadnix: skip' in self.tokens[j].val:
                    self.skip_next_line = self.tokens[j].line + 1
                j+=1
            if j >= in_pos:
                break
            t=self.tokens[j]
            if t.typ=='INHERIT':
                j+=1
                if j < in_pos and self.tokens[j].typ=='LPAREN':
                    depth2=1
                    j+=1
                    while j < in_pos and depth2>0:
                        if self.tokens[j].typ=='LPAREN':
                            depth2+=1
                        elif self.tokens[j].typ=='RPAREN':
                            depth2-=1
                        j+=1

def is_hidden_path(path):
    for part in pathlib.Path(path).parts:
        if part.startswith('.') and part not in ('.', '..'):
            return True
    return False

def collect_files(opts):
    cwd = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    excludes_abs = []
    for e in opts["excludes"]:
        p = pathlib.Path(e)
        if not p.is_absolute():
            p = (cwd / p).resolve()
        else:
            try:
                p = p.resolve()
            except:
                p = p.absolute()
        excludes_abs.append(p)
    def is_excluded(file_path):
        try:
            abs_path = pathlib.Path(file_path).resolve()
        except:
            abs_path = pathlib.Path(file_path).absolute()
        for ex in excludes_abs:
            try:
                if abs_path == ex or abs_path.is_relative_to(ex):
                    return True
            except AttributeError:
                if str(abs_path) == str(ex) or str(abs_path).startswith(str(ex) + os.sep):
                    return True
            except:
                if str(abs_path) == str(ex) or str(abs_path).startswith(str(ex) + os.sep):
                    return True
        return False

    collected = []
    for fp in opts["file_paths"]:
        p = pathlib.Path(fp)
        if not p.exists():
            collected.append(str(p))
            continue
        if p.is_file():
            if is_excluded(str(p)):
                continue
            collected.append(str(p))
        elif p.is_dir():
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(p), topdown=True):

        else:

    return collected

    e=dict(os.environ, NO_COLOR="1")
    r=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable"]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd, env=e)
    return r.stdout, r.stderr, r.returncode

def run_new(args, cwd=None):
    e=dict(os.environ, NO_COLOR="1")
    r=subprocess.run(["python3","/tmp/combined_final.py"]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd, env=e)
    return r.stdout, r.stderr, r.returncode

def compare_json(path, extra=[]):
    o,_,_ = run_orig(["--output-format","json",path]+extra)
    n,_,_ = run_new(["--output-format","json",path]+extra)
    # Compare as sets? Order may differ but we sort
    if o.strip()=="":
        o_json=[]
    else:
        o_json=[json.loads(l) for l in o.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
    if n.strip()=="":
        n_json=[]
    else:
        n_json=[json.loads(l) for l in n.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
    # Sort by file
    o_json=sorted(o_json, key=lambda x: x["file"])
    n_json=sorted(n_json, key=lambda x: x["file"])
    # For each file, sort results by line, col
    for j in o_json:
        j["results"]=sorted(j["results"], key=lambda x: (x.get("line",0), x.get("column",0)))
    for j in n_json:
        j["results"]=sorted(j["results"], key=lambda x: (x.get("line",0), x.get("column",0)))
    if o_json!=n_json:
        print(f"MISMATCH json {path} {extra}")
        print("orig", o_json)
        print("new ", n_json)
        return False
    return True
